title: The Deep Hulls
text: Two hulls have slid into the pit south-west of the rows and lie on their sides in ash that has set like stone. The oldest in the field. One stencil can still be read: ACCORD 1. Its drone bay is welded shut, from the inside.

lines.text: "From the inside. Somebody aboard didn't want to be opened. I'd like very much to know who, and I don't suppose we ever will."

tags: act 2, ash, hull field, optional, survivors
notes: Optional: not an objective. A nod to the Enclave (a run whose people got away from their own caretaker).
